0022600096.text: The Timberwolves (1-0, road 1-0) are 7th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, while the Orlando Magic (0-1, home 0-1) are 11th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, one game back. Minnesota has no games yet against Orlando this season, and the Timberwolves lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury (surgery), and Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain).
